all_threads/cpu.heap_alloc_bytes.reason: Every thread: the video decode thread's demuxer and decoder allocate according to how far decoding ahead got when each seek arrived. Measured spread: 3 full runs 15,046 to 15,056 allocations and 1,616,662 to 1,618,582 bytes; a 4th full run 15,198 allocations; 12 runs of scrub_24 alone 15,046 to 15,339 allocations (1.9%) and 1,521,120 to 1,538,422 bytes (1.1%), at load 29. The bench thread's own counts stay within 0.1%.

ungated.cache.bind_group.misses: Each miss is a bind group creation, which gpu.bind_group_creations already bounds.
ungated.cache.draw_reuse.misses: Turning the reuse off makes it zero while wall-clock rises (1 of 9 pairs agree): it measures the reuse, not the cost.
ungated.cache.media.misses: No paired run moved it (rank correlation 0.30).
ungated.cache.target_pool.misses: One configuration moves it (the open bench); r comes from that outlier alone.
ungated.cache.text.misses: r -0.12, no paired run moved it.
ungated.engine.glsl_compiles: r -0.15, no paired run moved it.
ungated.gpu.bind_group_layout_creations: No configuration of the correlation set moves it per unit (a one-time, cold cost); r across configurations comes from the open bench alone and no paired run moved it. Reported, not gated, until a paired experiment shows its cost.
ungated.gpu.buffer_allocs: Paired runs disagree (wall-clock followed it in 2 of 10 pairs); r 0.97 comes from one configuration.
ungated.gpu.command_encoders: Constant per unit in every configuration (r 0).
ungated.gpu.compute_passes: Varies only between the scrub bench and the rest (r -0.12); no paired run moved it.
ungated.gpu.pipeline_creations: No configuration of the correlation set moves it per unit (a one-time, cold cost); r across configurations comes from the open bench alone and no paired run moved it. Reported, not gated, until a paired experiment shows its cost.

ungated.gpu.readbacks: Export only and constant per frame (r 0.04, no paired run).
ungated.gpu.sampler_creations: r -0.15, no paired run moved it.

ungated.gpu.submits: Constant per unit in every configuration (r -0.04).
